### R0.3 Concrete Evidence Prerequisite: True Death Cause Attribution Implementation

All prerequisite implementation for R0.3 causal death attribution has been completed using native bounded reads and writes only, with zero terminal/shell/test execution. All production engine, kernel, legacy instincts, survival, and god files remain strictly read-only.

---

### Key Files Created & Modified

1. **[`tools/creature_balance_attribution.py`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/tools/creature_balance_attribution.py)** (NEW):
   - **Reversible instrumentation**: Runtime interception of [`apply_human_damage`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/at_the_beginning/systems/health/damage.py#L11), [`kernel._attack`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/at_the_beginning/systems/creatures/kernel.py#L325), and [`instinct_die`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/at_the_beginning/instincts_and_tools.py#L1142) without modifying production source code. Implements `install()` / `uninstall()` and `__enter__` / `__exit__` with bit-for-bit restoration even on raised exceptions.
   - **True causal attribution**: Captures exact victim identity (slot + UID at the time of the event), attacking creature UID and species when genuinely available, damage requested vs actual applied, overkill, phase/tick, and lethal transitions.
   - **Memory bounding**: Retains a finite latest damage ring per resident (default cap 16), finite first-death summaries (cap 8), and compact scalar aggregates. Total heap complexity is $O(1)$ over 120,000 ticks ($< 100$ KB).
   - **Slot recycling isolation**: [`on_human_reset`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/tools/creature_balance_attribution.py#L101) empties the resident damage ring, resets victim UID, and clears lethal state upon death and respawn so recycled slots never leak past history.
   - **Attribution honesty**: Unattributed HP loss is recorded as `unattributed_hp_loss` / `unknown` (never fabricated as wolf or old age). Zeroed rows without captured damage or old age are recorded as `unresolved_type_removal`.

2. **[`tools/creature_balance.py`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/tools/creature_balance.py)** (UPDATED):
   - Integrated [`AttributionObserver`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/tools/creature_balance_attribution.py#L58) into [`Balance.test_run`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/tools/creature_balance.py#L69) with automatic cleanup via `self.addCleanup(self.observer.uninstall)`.
   - Updated [`describe_death`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/tools/creature_balance.py#L162) to report true causal death summaries, preserving spatial proximity data for comparison and contrast.
   - Called `self.observer.on_human_reset(i)` upon resident resurrection to isolate slot history.
   - Documented [`feed()`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/tools/creature_balance.py#L176) harness semantics (needs, stamina, and age reset every tick so deaths measure creature combat pressure rather than economic sustainability).
   - Documented [`duels()`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/tools/creature_balance.py#L190) as closed-form formula estimates derived from table stats rather than simulated agent combat.
   - Expanded `RESULT` with `attribution` summary, `duels_formula_estimates`, and `feed_semantics`.

3. **[`tests/test_creature_balance_attribution_1010.py`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/tests/test_creature_balance_attribution_1010.py)** (NEW):
   - 9 comprehensive unit tests verifying:
     - Actual production [`apply_human_damage`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/at_the_beginning/systems/health/damage.py#L11) under lethal and non-lethal conditions.
     - Multiple same-tick sources and overkill accounting.
     - Nearby uninvolved animal is never assigned as killer (proving proximity $\neq$ causation).
     - Slot recycling history isolation.
     - Exception recovery and original function restoration.
     - Bounded rings and first-death cap.
     - Bit-identical tensor outputs and torch RNG preservation.
     - Genuine reporting of old age, unattributed HP drops, and unresolved type removals.
     - Duels formula estimates disclosure.

4. **[`coordination_evidence/agy_1010_balance_attribution_report.md`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/coordination_evidence/agy_1010_balance_attribution_report.md)** (NEW):
   - Detailed architectural documentation, memory-bounding specifications, test verification summary, and handoff instructions.
